name: Raunaq International Ltd
summary: Raunaq lnternational Limited engages in engineering contracting business in India. The company provides detailed engineering; procurement, inspection, and supply; quality assurance; construction and installation; testing and commissioning; and project management and supervision services. It also offers industrial piping systems, including low pressure power plant piping. utility industrial piping, large dia piping, ash/sludge disposal piping, and process piping; and cross-country pipeline and piping systems, storage tanks and oil handling systems, ash water recirculation systems, compressed air systems, and fire water systems, as well as offers site fabrication and equipment erection works. The company provides its services to the power, chemical, hydrocarbon, metal, and automobile sectors. The company was formerly known as Raunaq EPC International Limited and changed its name to Raunaq lnternational Limited in January 2024. Raunaq lnternational Limited was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Faridabad, India.
